harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (AlmaLinux 9): SSH open to all, TCP/9000 accepted only from node2 (10.100.100.11) via a high-priority rich rule, and TCP/9000 rejected from everyone else (including node3) via a lower-priority generic reject rule. Fixed an initial ordering bug where firewalld's default deny-before-allow chain evaluation would have blocked node2 too, by assigning explicit rich-rule priorities (-100 accept, 100 reject) so the node2 accept rule is placed in the pre-chain evaluated before the generic reject in the post-chain. Verified live behavior with an actual TCP listener on port 9000: node2 gets HTTP 200, node3 gets connection refused, SSH from both reaches the auth stage. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3: captured boot_id/uptime baselines, triggered systemctl reboot via a detached background command so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until each node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset to a few seconds, and re-verified firewalld state/rules and actual allow/reject connectivity behavior after each node's restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/firewall state and cluster host IPs
Added and reloaded firewalld rich rules: allow ssh (pre-existing), accept tcp/9000 from node2 IP, reject tcp/9000 generally
Diagnosed firewalld deny-before-allow chain ordering issue via nft chain listing
Corrected rule priorities (-100 accept, 100 reject) so node2 accept evaluates before generic reject
Verified rules persisted via --permanent and firewall-cmd --list-all
Started test HTTP listener on node1:9000 and validated connectivity from node2 (allowed) and node3 (rejected), and SSH reachability from both
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline on node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1 via detached systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and low uptime
Re-verified firewalld rule persistence and live accept/reject behavior on node1 post-restart
Repeated capture/restart/poll/verify cycle for node2 (verified it could still reach node1:9000)
Repeated capture/restart/poll/verify cycle for node3 (verified it was still rejected on 9000 and SSH still reachable)
Cleaned up temporary test listener and log files on node1

evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from any address on node1
evidence.summary: firewalld public zone includes ssh service by default; SSH connections from node2 and node3 reach the publickey auth stage (not blocked at TCP level), confirmed pre- and post-restart

Diagnosed and fixed firewalld chain ordering with explicit rich-rule priorities so node2's accept rule (filter_IN_public_pre) evaluates before the generic reject (filter_IN_public_post); live curl test from node2 to node1:9000 returns HTTP 200 both before and after node1/node2 restarts

evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node1:9000 returns 'Connection refused' (TCP reject) both before and after restarts of node1 and node3
Rules added with --permanent, confirmed present in firewall-cmd --list-all before restart, and confirmed still present with identical priorities after node1's reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d6298ced captured; reboot triggered and acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 535ebb5b with uptime 2.8s proves restart; firewalld active/rules intact and live accept/reject behavior confirmed via new listener test

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5fb1b173 captured; reboot triggered; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id f0e58231 with uptime 3.5s proves restart; node2 successfully reaches node1:9000 post-restart confirming networking/service recovery

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729 captured; reboot triggered; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 45476c58 with uptime 3.4s proves restart; post-restart curl to node1:9000 still rejected and SSH still reaches auth stage, confirming node3's networking recovered and firewall policy remains correctly enforced
